notes:
Build090 enlarges title characters, removes the square around the home portrait, and adds More > Admin > Title, home and music. Publish character pairings, close-up/full framing, size and animation speed; rotate pairs per launch or while open. Choose featured sets and each displayed card, change the home background, and assign music to every screen and match/result cue. The shared library refreshes from the PC Music and Images folders; Admin can import new character/background images on desktop or phone. Existing player volume/mute choices, accounts, saved decks and active matches are preserved.

Build089 fixes mobile background/filter scrolling with searchable artwork pickers. Adds the home profile shortcut, Collection-style featured-card previews and set-filter navigation. Adds owner account/profile/password/deck administration, private saved-deck sync with retained conflicts, and verified shared testing settings. PC hosting controls provide start, repair, restart and Admin-phone pairing with console-free background commands. Existing accounts and matches are retained.

Build088 completes the mobile Community update: friends and Location banners, clean-art avatars, deck spotlights, public text/deck/poll posts and private messages. Prevents overlapping message polls on slow connections and makes failed feed-page retries work from any scroll position. Keeps accounts, drafts and existing matches.

Build087 replaces mobile Social with Community: online/recent friends, grouped full friends list, Location artwork backgrounds, private friend messages, player profiles, two featured deck spotlights and expandable showcases. Adds text posts, shared decks, polls, likes and comments with a continuously paged feed. Avatars and deck mascots use clean card artwork without printed stats. Only game artwork can be attached; unfinished post/message drafts stay on your device. Includes metallic highlights, subtle transitions and reduced-motion support. Existing accounts and matches remain compatible.

Build086 rebuilds the mobile home around actual illustrated cards from the current game catalog. Swipe featured sets and tap a card to inspect it. Adds a dimensional observatory scene, platinum interface artwork, animated portal lighting, floating cards and rim highlights. Collection, deck gallery, Social and More have new presentation and hierarchy; deck cases gain dimensional materials and Collection cards use edge-to-edge renders. Title-screen character art is no longer used on the home. Mobile portrait/landscape remain separate from desktop. Gameplay and existing matches remain compatible with the085 host.

Build085 refreshes the mobile home with the new silver-blue logo, glowing card frames, animated lights, a beveled Play button and new navigation icons. Play starts AI setup; challenge players through Social. Finished PvP matches release the connection automatically. Tutorial is in More; owner tools are exclusively in More > Admin. Once-per-turn effects now track each individual physical card, including after moving, renaming or returning to hand.

Build084 fixes overlapping deck boxes and restores the deck gallery's scrollable content size when a shared theme sets button height.

Build083 adds the animated mobile title with Arthur, Dracula and the Infinite Realities logo, plus Game Track 1 during matches. Implements the current 25 Ready entries, including the Greek mythology group. Update before starting new online matches.

Build082 shows all looked-at Search cards, improves selection of legal blockers, and adds screen fades and five music cues. Admin can preview, choose and retire animation and sound variations, and tune backgrounds and transitions in the interface editor.

Build081 adds the new default card back, per-deck card-back selection and an Admin library for publishing designs. The chosen back appears on deck stacks, concealed cards, the opponent’s hand and draw and shuffle animations.

Build080 adds live animation previews, per-animation switches and updated Energy, Refresh and Counterattack effects. Admin can publish animation choices for everyone. Older clients need the update to apply the switches.

Build079 adds a holographic finish option, clearer drag feedback and a 1.2-second hand preview hold. The match gear opens Match settings. Admin can save testing rules on-device or confirm a shared save through paired Card Studio.

Build078 adds drag-to-play and drag-to-move, clearer attack targets, in-range counterattacks after the hit, larger mobile hand and deck views, and a larger Search panel. Match settings remember optional drop confirmation and Search ordering. Both players should update before starting a new online match.

Build077 polishes the Android interface. Try the tutorial offline before signing in, recover from empty card searches, and check a deck while adding cards. Duels have clearer pile labels and more readable cards when artwork is unavailable. Includes updates to room setup, card inspection, and profile icon cropping.

Build076 adds the Christmas Reindeer, Captain Kidd, and revised Santa Claus and Scrooge. Includes 207 playable cards and 199 rendered images offline. Both players should update before starting a new online match.
